lines.t: Yeah, I’m just a mailman, bag full of scrolls
Ain’t my ink on the page, I just walk where I’m told
Every good gift that I got came down from above
I’m clay in His hands, He the fountain of love
Knowledge puffed up, had me flexin’ my pen
Thought I owned revelation, He reminded me then
Mind ensnared in my pride, heart tucked in a cage
’Til His fire hit my chest, had me fall on my face
I decrease, You increase, burn my crown in the flame
Every bar that I speak, stamp Your holy Name
Let ’em all see the King, never mention mine
If they look at this vessel, let it be Your sign
This that humble pie, serve it up hot
If the beat go crazy, still the flesh get dropped
If the crowd say “fire”, let ’em know that it’s You
I’m just copy–paste, You the Word, You the Truth
Heylel tried to rise, but he fell like dust
You the Lord of the sound, every wave, every thump
From the light to the dark, You reign, no lie
So if they clap for the man, I throw it back to the Most High
Demons stay whisperin’, “You the one, you the star
You the genius in the booth, you the brains, you the heart”
Tryna bait my ego, fatten up my chest
But I’m nailed to the cross, there’s no glory left
If the melody slap, if the mix too clean
That’s the breath of El Shaddai in the space between
Even algorithms bow, every stream, every chart
He the Lord of the code, He the search of the heart
I ain’t chasin’ no plaques, I’m just fearin’ His Name
He can shut down the session, pull the plug on the game
So I tremble with the pen, treat the mic like a knife
Let His Word cut deep, bring the dead to life
I decrease, You increase, burn my crown in the flame
Every bar that I speak, stamp Your holy Name
Let ’em all see the King, never mention mine
If they look at this vessel, let it be Your sign
This that humble pie, serve it up hot
If the beat go crazy, still the flesh get dropped
If the crowd say “fire”, let ’em know that it’s You
I’m just copy–paste, You the Word, You the Truth
Heylel tried to rise, but he fell like dust
You the Lord of the sound, every wave, every thump
From the light to the dark, You reign, no lie
So if they clap for the man, I throw it back to the Most High
I don’t wanna touch Your glory,
Take it all, take it all, it’s Yours
I don’t wanna sip that poison,
Flattery that opens doors
If they cheer for this creation,
Let ’em meet the Living Word
YahuShua, only Sovereign,
Over heaven, over earth
Hands up – not for me, for the King on high
Hands up – every knee, every tongue comply
Hands up – over light, over dark, He reigns
Hands up – Mashiach, only Name
He the Lord of distortion, Lord of every tone
Lord of thunder in the kick, of the silence in the phone
If I type, if I track, if I slice, if I loop
If I drag, if I drop, that’s His hand on the route
Heylel once covered stones, music in his frame
Tried to rise past the Throne, now he chokes in shame
But my King took the nails, wore the thorns, broke the grave
Now we trumpet out His words, every soul He’ll save
I’m a herald in the night, watchman on the wall
If the beat wake the dead, that’s the Spirit, not my call
I’m just breathing in the script, then I’m breathing out the sound
Blow the trumpet in the city, let His glory shake the ground
We decrease, You increase, write Your law on our hearts
Every servant in the ranks, take the lowliest part
Make us faithful little messengers, door to door
We deliver not our speech, only Yours, nothing more
This that humble pie, serve it up hot
If the beat go crazy, still the flesh get dropped
If the crowd say “fire”, let ’em know that it’s You
We just copy–paste, You the Word, You the Truth
Heylel tried to rise, but he fell like dust
You the Lord of the sound, every wave, every thump
From the light to the dark, You reign, Most High
We bow low, stay low, while Your Name gets glorified
Source of all good, every gift, every breath
YahuShua, Sovereign over life and death
Light of the world, Lord of the night
We’re just postmen… You’re the Message, You’re the Light
